ONE test per card: 12 deg oblique steps, ABOVE FineAngle=6 and into the roll-to-align blend (full at AlignAngle=25). Same diamond geometry as oblique-2/-6, radius 8.49 deg. The DR/DL steps end below the horizon - the v0.85 elDn regime, reached obliquely. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition.
